ai_analysis.summary: The post gives informal job-search advice for people seeking more interviews, including tailoring resumes and profiles to job descriptions, using relevant keywords, applying to many openings, contacting recruiters directly, and using multiple platforms such as LinkedIn and referral networks. It mentions PySpark, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks only as examples of Data Engineering keywords, without explaining any technical concepts. It also promotes the author's free newsletter and does not substantiate its claim that these tactics will produce more interviews.
